note: Editorial framing for the three chapters (D1). Shared by the landing page and /chapter/[id] so the blurbs don't drift between them. `mixSource` names where that chapter's interest mix is read from: 'trip1'/'trip2' read comparison.interestMix VERBATIM (D27 — summing per-city counts re-derives an authoritative number and disagrees with it), while 'city' means the chapter is a single city and shows that city's own tag counts.

west.blurb: Leaving home the long way: high desert, two mountain systems, and the loneliest stretches of the whole arc.
west.curation: Self-curated. No published guide existed for these cities at the time — every stop came off a list made beforehand, by hand.

nola.blurb: Eleven days in the one American city that is entirely its own country. A festival, not a stop.
nola.curation: Neither method. The interlude sits between the two trips and had no guide at the time — it ran on a saved list alone.

south.blurb: Austin to Philadelphia through the geography of the movement: Jackson, Birmingham, Atlanta, and the road between.
south.curation: Sourced curation. Every city on this leg had a ten-category guide built from Atlas Obscura, Eater, Time Out and TasteAtlas before departure.

sideTrip.where: Greensboro, NC — en route Charlotte → Richmond
sideTrip.note: The International Civil Rights Center & Museum, at the Woolworth sit-in counter. A civil-rights-corridor stop that appeared in no guide, on the trip that had guides for everything.
